sponsored.t: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation; repealer
sponsored.sum: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation and transfers any remaining records, property, rights, titles, and interest to the Clifton-Fine health care corporation d/b/a Clifton-Fine hospital, a New York not-for-profit corporation and its successors or assigns.

sponsored.t: Establishes a municipal exemption from commercial driver's license requirements
sponsored.sum: Establishes a municipal exemption from commercial driver's license requirements when the vehicle utilized is owned or leased by a city, town, village, or county when such vehicle is operated by a municipal employee solely for intrastate governmental purposes.

sponsored.t: Directs court to establish a period of commitment for persons found not responsible by reason of mental disease or defect
sponsored.sum: Directs a criminal court to establish a period of commitment for persons found not responsible by reason of mental disease or defect; a person so committed shall not be eligible for release from the custody of the commissioner of mental health or the commissioner of developmental disabilities until completion of the period of commitment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of games of chance by employees of authorized organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the operation of games of chance by employees of authorized organizations.

sponsored.t: Relates to conveying land to the town of Montague, Lewis county, in order to allow the expansion of the town's barn for public use
sponsored.sum: Relates to conveying approximately 1.2 acres of land located within the forest preserve to the town of Montague, Lewis county, in order to allow the expansion of the town's barn for public use, in exchange for 26 acres of land to be conveyed by such town to the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the sale of consumer fireworks in the state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sale of consumer fireworks in the state; allows fireworks to be sold between May and December; requires compliance with certain requirements regarding registration and facilities; imposes a tax on the sale of fireworks.

sponsored.t: Provides for statewide video arraignments
sponsored.sum: Provides that the court may, in its discretion, dispense with the defendant's personal appearance at an arraignment and conduct an electronic arraignment.

sponsored.t: Relates to certification of inspectors of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to certification of inspectors of motor vehicles and the standards of competency and fitness they shall meet in order to be certified.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the issuance of distinctive legion of valor license plates
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the issuance of distinctive legion of valor license plates for individuals who have received the army medal of honor, navy medal of honor, air force medal of honor, army distinguished service cross, navy cross, coast guard cross, or air force cross.

sponsored.t: Establishes and authorizes telepharmacy in this state
sponsored.sum: Establishes and authorizes telepharmacy in this state; defines terms; creates telepharmacy satellite consultation sites and telepharmacy in hospitals; authorizes the filling of prescriptions at remote sites connected to central pharmacies via computer link, videolink and audiolink; makes exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to prompt payments to counties by the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to prompt payments to counties by the state; provides if prompt payment is not provided an interest payment shall be made to the contractor or county government.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the photo image fee for veterans who have their license amended with a veteran notation
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the photo image fee for veterans who have their license or identification cards amended with a veteran notation.

sponsored.t: Provides for establishment of school speed limits by county legislative body
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of school speed limits of not less than fifteen miles per hour by the legislative body of any county or, if so delegated, by the legislative body of any locality within said county on a portion of a state highway passing a school building.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the biomass fired exception program
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the biomass fired exception program providing an exception for certain biomass fired electric generation facilities to the definition of a fossil fuel-fired facility for purposes of a CO2 budget trading program.

sponsored.t: Provides for insurance premium reductions for successful completion of a fraud prevention course
sponsored.sum: Provides for insurance premium reductions for successful completion of a fraud prevention course, known as the New York auto fraud prevention program.

sponsored.t: Allows residents who are employed by employers based in another state to obtain property/casualty or liability coverage under a policy issued to their employer
sponsored.sum: Allows residents who are employed by employers based in another state to obtain property/casualty or liability coverage under a policy issued to their employer in that state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a person to pass their guns to an immediate family member through their estate
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a person to pass their guns to an immediate family member through their estate.

sponsored.t: Creates distinctive license plates for the United States army 10th mountain division
sponsored.sum: Creates distinctive license plates for members and supporters of the United States army 10th mountain division.

sponsored.t: Relates to repealing section 7718 of the insurance law, relating to the prohibited advertisement of the corporation in sale of insurance
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the prohibited advertisement of the corporation in sale of insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of signatures for independent nominating petitions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the number of signatures for independent nominating petitions; decreases the number of signatures and votes to 15,000 signatures for statewide candidates and 50,000 votes to maintain party ballot status; changes the petition period to 12 weeks and the petitioning time to May-August.

sponsored.t: Relates to pistol permit applications for military personnel
sponsored.sum: Relates to pistol permit applications for military personnel; requires the licensing officer to act on an application for any member of the active or reserve component of the armed forces within 90 days of presentment.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York automobile insurance fraud and premium reduction act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York automobile insurance fraud and premium reduction act; provides that this act is aimed at reducing insurance fraud and thus lowering the cost of insurance premiums; provides a provision for compensation to a person that reports insurance fraud to the authorities; further provides that this act also increases the penalty for insurance fraud; appropriates $3,100,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring antique, classic or collectors cars be inspected for safety biennially instead of annually
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring that antique, classic or collectors cars be inspected for safety biennially instead of annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing electronic toll collection devises for milk dealers free of charge
sponsored.sum: Provides milk dealers who operate trucks throughout the state buying, delivering, and selling milk with an EZ pass free of charge, where the authority will be responsible for the cost so long as it can be proved the truck is used exclusively for such purpose.

sponsored.t: Establishes minimum maintenance roads in the town of Montague, Lewis county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Montague in Lewis county to designate certain town roads as low-volume roads and certain low-volume roads as minimum maintenance roads.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the town of Dekalb, in the county of St. Lawrence, to reduce the maximum speed limit on certain public roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Dekalb, in the county of St. Lawrence, to reduce the maximum speed limit on a portion of United States route eleven.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain solar or wind energy projects in the county of Lewis from certain appraisal models and discount rates
sponsored.sum: Excludes solar or wind energy projects in the county of Lewis that were already in existence on the effective date of Part N of chapter 59 of the laws of 2023 from certain appraisal models and discount rates.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax exemption for background check fees
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sales tax exemption for fees imposed on national instant criminal background checks.

sponsored.t: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production
sponsored.sum: Includes land used for processing or retail merchandising of agricultural products within the real property tax exemption for land used in agricultural production.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions establishing a fee for background checks on certain firearm and ammunition purchases and amends the source of funds for the background check fund accordingly
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions establishing a fee for background checks on certain firearm and ammunition purchases; removes such fees as a source of funds for the background check fund.

sponsored.t: Allows students attending agricultural learning events to be counted as in attendance at school
sponsored.sum: Allows students attending agricultural learning events to be counted as in attendance at school; defines "agricultural learning events" as including FFA events and 4-H programs.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 37-0121 of the environmental conservation law
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions of law relating to the prohibition against the use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in apparel and outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of body scanners in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of body scanners in correctional facilities by both visitors and incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Requires insurers to send notices of renewal of certain policies to the insured no later than thirty days prior to the expiration of the policy
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to send a notice of renewal or extension of certain policies to the insured no later than thirty days prior to the expiration of the policy.

sponsored.t: Establishes the joint insurance fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that the governing body of municipal corporation, may by resolution agree to join together with any municipal corporation or corporations to establish a joint insurance fund for the purpose of insuring against liability, property damage, and workers' compensation, insuring against loss or theft of moneys or securities, providing blanket bond coverage of certain county or municipal officers and employees for faithful performance and discharge of their duties under the public officers' law, insuring against bodily injury and property damage claims arising from environmental impairment liability and legal representation therefor; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Increases the reimbursement amount authorized to be paid to localities maintaining incarcerated individuals convicted of felonies
sponsored.sum: Increases the reimbursement amount authorized to be paid to localities maintaining incarcerated individuals convicted of felonies to $300 per day per capita for the first 10 days, and $600 per day per capita for each day thereafter, or the actual per day per capita cost, whichever is more.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization for the county of Lewis to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends authorization for the county of Lewis to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Jefferson to impose additional sales tax until November 30th, 2027.
